expectedAuthority: Cloudflare API access restricted to intended DNS zones and Pages accounts
credentialRequirements.description: Bearer token held only by the Credential Adapter and resolved as CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN. Authority is descriptive, not an OAuth scope.

dns_records_create.description:
Create a new DNS record for a zone.

Notes:
- A/AAAA records cannot exist on the same name as CNAME records.
- NS records cannot exist on the same name as any other record type.
- Domain names are always represented in Punycode, even if Unicode
  characters were used when creating the record.

POST /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records

dns_records_delete.description:
Permanently removes a DNS record from the zone.

DELETE /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{dns_record_id}

dns_records_edit.description:
Update an existing DNS record.

Notes:
- A/AAAA records cannot exist on the same name as CNAME records.
- NS records cannot exist on the same name as any other record type.
- Domain names are always represented in Punycode, even if Unicode
  characters were used when creating the record.

PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{dns_record_id}

dns_records_update.description:
Overwrite an existing DNS record.

Notes:
- A/AAAA records cannot exist on the same name as CNAME records.
- NS records cannot exist on the same name as any other record type.
- Domain names are always represented in Punycode, even if Unicode
  characters were used when creating the record.

PUT /zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{dns_record_id}

pages_delete.description:
Permanently delete a Cloudflare Pages project and its deployments.

DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}

pages_deployments_create.description:
Create a Cloudflare Pages deployment from a Git branch or Direct Upload manifest. Git repositories must already be authorized in Cloudflare Pages.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/deployments

pages_deployments_delete.description:
Remove a deployment from a Cloudflare Pages project.

DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/deployments/{deployment_id}

pages_deployments_retry.description:
Retry a previous Cloudflare Pages deployment.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/deployments/{deployment_id}/retry

pages_deployments_rollback.description:
Roll back production to a previous successful Cloudflare Pages deployment.

Confirm with the user before calling this tool. This operation rolls back the production deployment to an earlier deployment.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/deployments/{deployment_id}/rollback

pages_domains_create.description:
Attach a custom domain to a Cloudflare Pages project.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/domains

pages_domains_delete.description:
Remove a custom domain from a Cloudflare Pages project.

DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/domains/{domain_name}

pages_domains_validation_retry.description:
Retry validation for a custom domain attached to a Cloudflare Pages project.

PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/domains/{domain_name}

pages_source_connect.description:
Connect a GitHub or GitLab repository to a Cloudflare Pages project to enable Git-based deployments.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/source

pages_source_disconnect.description:
Disconnect the Git repository from a Cloudflare Pages project to stop Git-based deployments.

DELETE /accounts/{account_id}/pages/projects/{project_name}/source
